changes: Find PrintStream’s Android, Windows, and Linux apps from the new Apps section, including Linux AppImage and Debian packages for x64 and ARM64.
Check for updates from App settings, with installation handled by Google Play, Microsoft Store, or the matching Linux package.
Windows app updates now always carry the current PrintStream version, so a new package reliably replaces the installed app.
MakerWorld URL imports now use your bridge connection and retry one-off protection errors automatically.
Bambu Cloud sign-in now completes correctly for accounts protected by an authenticator code.
Firmware update checks now distinguish downloadable updates from newer announcements that are not yet available to install.
Native app updates now reliably show their bundled interface instead of reopening an older downloaded version.
Native notifications now open the intended server, workspace, and page more reliably, including support messages and self-hosted backup alerts.
Native App settings now lists known notification workspaces as inline switches, and Back returns to the page that opened settings.
Android users can discover the native app from a one-time prompt after signing in on the web.
Model Studio keeps full-screen controls below native status bars and prevents a two-finger pan from unexpectedly becoming an orbit.
Material calibration now matches presets to the loaded material and uses clearer, more compact page copy.
Help & feedback now opens correctly from the main navigation menu.
Navigation and page actions now fit better on phones, with secondary destinations collected in one larger menu.
Jobs now show whether they are print or slicing jobs and can be filtered by type.
Model Studio keeps mobile tools reachable, keeps full-screen exits below native status bars, and keeps selection bounds accurate while rotating or scaling.
Settings, empty states, license controls, library uploads, and printer links are clearer and less repetitive.
Workspace and account controls now use a cleaner footer layout, with Settings always available and App settings accessible from the Settings page on native apps.
Workspace switchers now prioritize everyday workspaces and list administrative workspaces last.
Platform notifications now open the relevant administrative page.
Single-printer pages no longer show unnecessary fleet sorting and filtering controls.
Notifications you open or dismiss now clear across your signed-in Windows, Android, and browser devices.
Camera snapshots now appear in Android and Windows notifications.
Tapping an Android notification after the app has been idle opens the intended server and workspace.
Windows notifications now show the PrintStream icon consistently.
New PrintStream apps for Android and Windows
Easily connect to and switch between cloud workspaces and self-hosted installations
Use PrintStream on Android with cloud or self-hosted connections and passkey sign-in.
Receive phone notifications even when the app is closed, including when running your own server.
Find signup and account-deletion options more easily.
Save and reuse calibration results for your printers and filament.
Organize printers, files and filament with tags, and preserve those tags in print history.
Add library models to new 3D projects and import large files more reliably.
Use improved mobile controls and replace materials more easily in Model Studio.
Cloud backups are now kept for 30 days so deleted account data does not linger in older backups. This shortens the recovery window; self-hosted backup settings are unchanged.
Redesigned the 3D and G-code previewers with responsive layouts, full-screen viewing, stable loading progress, and controls that no longer cover the model.
Improved G-code inspection with separate layer and move scrubbers, first-move replay, selected-layer isolation, clearer event markers, and mobile-friendly toolpath statistics.
Added direct 3D preview access while preparing a print, and improved camera gestures, object selection feedback, initial framing, and scene-building transitions.
Import FBX models and preserve colours and textures from FBX, OBJ, and glTF files in Model Studio.
Convert imported source colours into configurable filament painting with colour reduction, smoothing, matching previews, and undo support.
Simplify detailed meshes while preserving painted regions, with adjustable detail levels and previews.
View and edit project metadata, attachments, cover images, and other BambuStudio project files without losing them when saving or slicing.
Reuse unchanged slicing results, show clearer multi-plate progress, and report sliced material usage more accurately.
Customize printer build volumes, origins, printable heights, and bed appearance for workspace machine presets.
Control supported printer protection modes, camera resolution, nozzle-rack maintenance, and additional Bambu printer settings.
Use printer-specific print options including automatic calibration modes, timelapse storage, nozzle-offset calibration, and external-spool change assistance.
Preview printer-model mismatches before dispatch and explicitly approve cross-model prints when appropriate.
Keep selected jobs in the print queue after completion and use improved material mapping, printer selection, and dispatch safeguards.
Scan filament barcodes to identify materials, prefill spool details, and expose tracked inventory in Model Studio.
Manage library files, printer storage, filament, and slicing presets with improved bulk selection, sorting, grouping, filtering, and mobile layouts.
Access support and suggestions directly from licensed self-hosted installations, with clearer conversation attribution and unread replies.
Apply for education and community access through the cloud signup flow.
View version-specific release notes from the app footer.
